_comment: Licence metadata for every package pinned in Cargo.lock.
Cargo.lock records names, versions and checksums, but it does NOT record
licences. This file is therefore a checked-in transcription of the
licence each package declares in its own published manifest, taken from
the per-dependency table in LICENSES.md (Appendix A), which was read
from the crates.io manifests of the exact versions pinned here.
packaging/notices/generate_notices.py reads Cargo.lock and this file to
produce THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md. If a dependency is added or upgraded,
this file has to be updated in the same change; the generator fails
loudly when a package in Cargo.lock has no entry here.
source: LICENSES.md Appendix A (licence field of each crate's published Cargo.toml)
